# This file was automatically generated with PreTeXt 2.52.2.
pretext == 2.52.2

# TEMPORARY PIN -- do not drop without testing a build first.
#
# lxml 6.1.3 (2026-09-02) fixed LP#2165901: "External parameter entity
# parsing was allowed by default (with resolve_entities='internal')".
# That is a deliberate security hardening, and it is not coming back.
#
# PreTeXt's own core stylesheets rely on the old behaviour.  Every one of
# them opens with an internal DTD subset that pulls in the shared entity
# file, e.g. xsl/utilities/report-publisher-variables.xsl:
#
#     <!DOCTYPE xsl:stylesheet [
#         <!ENTITY % entities SYSTEM "../entities.ent">
#         %entities;
#     ]>
#
# and pretext/core/common.py:283 parses the stylesheet with lxml's default
# parser (`xsl_tree = ET.parse(xsl)`), which no longer expands that external
# parameter entity.  So on lxml 6.1.3 every `pretext build` dies with
#
#     fatal: Entity 'entities' not defined, line 25, column 15
#
# before writing a single page.  This affects all current PreTeXt releases
# (verified on 2.49.1, 2.52.2 and 2.52.3.dev20260903104539), so pinning lxml
# is the only fix available on our side today.
#
# Remove this pin once PreTeXt parses its stylesheets with a parser that
# opts in explicitly (resolve_entities=True), or once upstream drops the
# external-entity DOCTYPE from the core XSL.
lxml == 6.1.2
